data.introduce:
HU-21 Swampwalker
The UKB-1 designed this heavy tactical ST to tackle the unique terrain of jungle regions.
It is best suited for providing firepower support during rainforest combat. With its unique joint design and suspension, it can smoothly traverse swamps and maintain balance even under intense fire.
